text:
Elaine: Morning — noticed nightly eval CI throughput dropped ~40% after yesterday's runtime change. Build queue piling up, many eval jobs timing out. Anyone else seeing this?
Josh: saw alerts too, +1. Link to failing jobs: https://ci.redwood.ai/job/ev-run/5423
CI-bot: Job ev-run/5423 started at 2026-03-19T02:34Z — logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/log/5423
Maria: I ran the perf bench locally against master vs HEAD; tokens/s: master=220 tok/s, HEAD=128 tok/s on same hw. Reproducible.
Ankur: interesting. What changed in HEAD? any recent quant/kernel patches?
Maria: suspecting commit 9a7f5c2 — 'batching: prefer oldest request to reduce latency' — might reduce batch sizes for eval runner.
Josh: if batch sizes drop throughput will drop. But eval harness usually has long sequences — smaller batches shouldn't affect that much.
Elaine: attaching a short log excerpt from ev-run/5423:

``
[runner] model=redwood-v2-q4 kernel=q4_8_cuda seq=2048 batch=1 tokens/s=130
[runner] model=redwood-v2-q4 kernel=q4_8_cuda seq=2048 batch=8 tokens/s=220
```

Maria: HEAD shows batch=1 more frequently; we also see more KV cache flushes: "kv_eviction=true" toggles.
Ankur: kv eviction increasing could be a side-effect of batcher reordering — evict when we can't reuse prefix cache.
Josh: can we bisect quickly? Maria — can you run the bisect on the range from 9a7f5c2..HEAD?
Maria: running bisection now, will ping when I have candidate commit.
~20m later~
Maria: bisect points to commit 9a7f5c2 (author: devinfra) — change to batcher heuristics. Reproducible on minimal harness with synthetic traffic. Patch reduces average batch size from 6->2.
Elaine: sounds like a regression in throughput. Proposed options: 1) roll back 9a7f5c2 on eval CI (fast), 2) hotfix batcher to keep high throughput for eval traffic, 3) tweak eval harness to send more concurrent reqs (workaround).
Ankur: prefer rollback for eval CI so we can clear backlog and release won't be blocked. Need to create issue for proper fix.
Josh: +1 rollback on CI only. We should keep prod config as-is until we have perf-preserving change.
SRE-bot: Rolling back runtime @ eval cluster -> initiating deploy... :gear:
SRE-bot: Rollback complete on eval clusters at 2026-03-19T03:12Z — ev-run queue draining.
Elaine: after rollback tokens/s back to 215-225 on a few sample runs. Queue down to normal.
Maria: opened ticket MLINF-3421 with bisect artifacts and perf traces, assigning to devinfra. Will follow up with a benchmark PR that stresses small/large batch mixes.
Ankur: also add a regression test to eval CI that checks median tokens/s for a small suite — fail build if below threshold.
Josh: noted — I'll add the CI gating change.
Elaine: thanks all. Next steps: Maria sends PR for perf test, DevInfra triages patch, Josh adds gating, we'll keep this thread for updates. :thumbsup:
